portal-bridge.description: Spotify Portal MCP via mcp-remote bridge with CIMD (SEP-991). Requires: (1) auth.kooshapari.com DNS + Cloudflare Worker deployed (currently NXDOMAIN, see STATE.md §24.1) and (2) URL added to Portal allow-list. Arg order fixed 2026-10-17: server URL is first positional arg (mcp-remote 0.15.1 contract). See docs/sessions/2026-10-15-portal-xirp-resume/XJ-03-DEPLOY.md.

blocked_on: Cloudflare Worker deployed at auth.kooshapari.com serving application/json at /oauth/client-metadata.json
Portal App Settings -> Allowed client ID patterns includes https://auth.kooshapari.com/*
_deploy_notes.arg_order_fixed: 2026-10-17 — server URL is first positional arg, mcp-remote 0.15.1 contract. Prior order (--transport before URL) caused 'TypeError: Invalid URL ... input: --transport'.
